name: Gross inventory reduction
target: >= 10% (quarterly / yearly), against the lowest month-end of the past FY
period: FY2025-26 to date (Apr to Dec 2025), as-of 2025-12-31
baseline: Lowest month-end of FY2024-25: INR 50,838,571.29 on 2025-01-31 (50 demo materials)
definition: (baseline - closing value) / baseline. Closing value = RAW FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT CLOSING_QTY x DIM_MATERIAL UNIT_COST_INR, plant HZL_DEMO_05, the 50 demo materials.
detail: Closing INR 78,735,327.75 against baseline INR 50,838,571.29. Not a reduction. Any fall seen elsewhere is not claimed for this system.

curated.label: Curated plant-wide (INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY), different scope
curated.display: 6.44% reduction; baseline INR 1,154,272,460.99 on 2025-02, closing INR 1,079,888,374.64

name: NM inventory reduction (NMI)
definition: Month-on-month fall in value of material classed NON_MOVING.
detail: RAW MATERIAL_PLANT_CLASSIFICATION holds one as-of date (2025-12-31) and the 50 demo materials have 0 NON_MOVING. No prior month to compare, and the non-moving window is not recorded in the data.

curated.label: Curated plant-wide NON_MOVING_VALUE_INR, not reconciled to RAW
curated.display: 12.4% lower (INR 51,151,671.21 to INR 44,806,736.02). Simulated baseline; not attributed to this system.

name: SM inventory reduction (SMI)
definition: Month-on-month fall in value of material classed SLOW_MOVING.
detail: RAW has one classification date, so no month-on-month series. The 50 demo materials hold 2 SLOW_MOVING lines worth INR 4,028,808.41 at 2025-12-31; the slow-moving window is not recorded in the data.

curated.label: Curated plant-wide SLOW_MOVING_VALUE_INR, not reconciled to RAW

name: Obsolete conversion
definition: Year-on-year fall in OBSOLETE value through conversion or disposal.
detail: The 50 demo materials have 0 OBSOLETE lines at 2025-12-31 and RAW has no earlier classification. Conversion events are not in the demo tables.

curated.label: Curated plant-wide OBSOLETE_VALUE_INR, not reconciled to RAW
curated.display: INR 570,769,290.12 to INR 61,453,759.22. Simulated baseline; whether it came from conversion or a customer-side initiative is unknown, so none of it is claimed.

name: Demand quantity prediction
period: Holdout Jul to Dec 2025 (6 months, never seen by the model); forward Jan to Jun 2026
baseline: Holdout actuals, 50 series x 6 months = 300 rows
definition: Demand accuracy = 1 - WAPE on held-out months, WAPE = sum |actual - predicted| / sum actual. Coverage = series with a forward forecast / series in scope.
display: 16.26% accuracy; forward forecast for 45 of 50 series (90.0%)
detail: WAPE 0.8374. Five series have no forward forecast: HZL1005107, HZL1005876, HZL1005880, HZL1005932, HZL1005933. ContextFlow predict-batch output was truncated for them (issue #21); nothing was forecast by hand.

name: Inventory forecast accuracy
period: Holdout Jul to Dec 2025 (6 months); last 3 months Oct to Dec 2025 shown for comparison
definition: 1 - WAPE on the same held-out months. ContextFlow was asked for demand only; no separate inventory-level forecast was run.
detail: WAPE 0.8374 (6 months), 0.8543 (3 months). 87.67% of actuals fell inside the engine interval. Engine warning quoted on the forecast page.

name: Potential NM/SM prediction
definition: F1 of predicted NM/SM against the actual class on held-out periods.
detail: No NM/SM classifier was run on ContextFlow. The only NM/SM data are current labels, with no forward class to score. F1 is not estimated.

name: Critical spares availability
definition: VITAL materials with closing stock > 0 / VITAL materials, plant HZL_DEMO_05, 50 demo materials.
detail: Two VITAL materials have zero stock: HZL1004843 and HZL1004853. Both are on the PR page marked raise now.

name: Real-time MRP/ROP adjustment
definition: Materials with a recalculated ROP / materials in scope. Real time means a live feed; this build is a batch.
display: 90.0% recalculated (45 of 50); 42 of 45 differ from master by more than 20%
detail: Five series have no forward forecast, so no ROP. The real-time claim is not demonstrated: there is no live feed in the demo. MRP type (VB/PD) is not computable on demo scope: no such column in RAW.

name: Duplicate SKU identification
definition: Duplicate = two or more ZSPR/ZSPN materials with an identical description. Recall against a labelled list cannot be computed: none exists.
display: 4 duplicate groups touching 4 of the 50 materials (candidates, not scored)
detail: The 100% target needs a labelled ground truth, which the demo does not have. Candidates found by exact description only; near-duplicates are not searched.

name: PR date suggestion
definition: Materials with a suggested PR date / materials in scope, where a date is the day the projected position reaches calculated ROP.
display: 90.0% assessed (45 of 50); 37 lines due, 29 raise now
detail: Five materials cannot be assessed (no forward forecast). 37 lines, INR 106,631,499.92, have a suggested date within 90 days.

curated.label: Curated REORDER_RECOMMENDATION
curated.display: 18 lines against 37 derived here: diverges, both shown

name: PR count reduction
period: FY2025-26 to date (Apr to Dec 2025) against Apr to Dec 2024
definition: Fall in non-cancelled PR lines for the 50 demo materials, same months in consecutive FYs. Observed, not a result of this system: it is not live.
display: 8.43% reduction (261 to 239 lines); calendar 2025 against 2024: 11.56% reduction (372 to 329)
detail: Below the 10% target on the FY basis (8.43%). The calendar-year cut (11.56%) is above 10% but covers a different window; the FY basis is the one the brief defines, and neither is attributed to this system.

curated.label: Curated PR_COUNT, plant-wide, calendar year
